commentary.title: A Record of Nephi’s People

publication.source_title: Book of Mormon Student Manual (1996 Edition)
publication.source_publisher: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

commentary.text: Nephi wrote this record about thirty years after Lehi’s colony left Jerusalem and journeyed to the promised land (see 1 Nephi 19:1–5, 2 Nephi 5:28–31).
